_about: 10 claims for week7's agent-vs-workflow race. 8 of the 10 (raw_notes, form, edition, endorsement, claimed_amount where present, and the pay/deny call + exclusion code in `expected`) are reconstructed from summary_goldenset.json's PDF-verified cases (see `source_goldenset_id`) by substituting real synthetic claim_id/claimant names back into the redacted [CLAIM_NO_1]/[CLAIMANT_1] placeholders. `claimed_amount_source: "supplemented"` marks the 3 cases (s06, s16, s20) whose original goldenset notes stated no dollar estimate -- those amounts are invented for this exercise, not PDF-sourced. get_claim() is the only reader of raw_notes; it must run redact.redact() on it before handing anything to a model, exactly like rag.py/summarize.py do at ingress. `expected` is the race scorer's ground truth and must never be returned by get_claim() or any tool.
